Specify a SIMP model

simp.Rd

Create a model specification for compositional data. This function validates the formula, data, and priors, and constructs the model object. The model is not fitted until fit() is called (v0.3.0+).

Usage

simp(formula, data, family = simp_dirichlet(), prior = NULL, validate = TRUE)

Arguments

formula

A model formula. The response should be a simp_composition or simp_cover object, or a matrix/data frame of compositional data. Random effects use lme4-style syntax: (1 | group), (1 + x | group), etc.

data

A data frame containing the predictor variables

family

A family object specifying the likelihood. See simp_dirichlet(), simp_logistic_normal(), simp_hurdle_dirichlet(), simp_stick_breaking().

prior

A simp_priors object, or NULL to use family defaults

validate

Logical; validate the response data (default TRUE)

Value

A simp_model object

Examples

# Create some example data
set.seed(42)
n <- 50
site <- factor(rep(1:10, each = 5))
temp <- rnorm(n)

# Compositional response (3 components)
props <- matrix(runif(n * 3), ncol = 3)
props <- props / rowSums(props)
cover <- simp_composition(props, components = c("grass", "shrub", "bare"))

# Create data frame
dat <- data.frame(temp = temp, site = site)

# Basic model specification
model <- simp(cover ~ temp, data = dat)
print(model)

# With random effects
model <- simp(cover ~ temp + (1 | site), data = dat)

# With custom family and priors
model <- simp(
  cover ~ temp + (1 | site),
  data = dat,
  family = simp_dirichlet(),
  prior = simp_priors(beta = prior_normal(0, 5))
)
